name: Quantity And Account 107
definition: Details on a quantity, account and other related information.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

DenominationChoice.name: Denomination Choice
DenominationChoice.definition: Denomination of the security to be received or delivered.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

QuantityBreakdown.name: Quantity Breakdown
QuantityBreakdown.definition: Breakdown of a quantity into lots such as tax lots, instrument series.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

DenominationRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the account owner and servicer, if DenominationChoice is used, it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

SafekeepingPlaceRule.definition: The SafekeepingPlace functionality in the settlement instructions is only to be used for global custodians that allow their clients to specify where the securities are to be held, for example, in an ICSD account versus an account at the local CSD.
